name: "Every Christmas {mom} NEEDS this" + store-shelf reaction
status: PROVEN externally (5.2M, 1.4M, 1.1M, 892K organic) and internally (524K, Merry Carrier 62.8K). Internal n=2 winners, so Tier B.
summary: A declarative 'every {identity} NEEDS this' line over a shocked shopper in an aisle (or a POV hand grabbing the box off a shelf), then the fastest possible product demo.
why: hollyglow27 'EVERY Christmas Mom NEEDS this 🎄😱' 5.2M / 39.5K shares in only 7.85 s (POV hand grabs boxed projector off a red shelf) (X).
merry.made2 'Every Christmas mom NEEDS this 😳❄️' 1.4M / 24.7K shares on a robe in a Target-style aisle; tryglowmas 1.1M; carolvyl 892K (X).
Internal: 524K 'ALL mom's NEED this 😳❄️' (muffin tin) and Merry Carrier 62.8K 'Every Christmas mom NEEDS this 😏❄️' (Insights 3s 34%, avg 6 s).
Same text family failed when re-texted onto don't-show footage: 'EVERY Grandma NEEDS this..' 4.2K on the 183K footage.

shots.content: POV hand pulls the branded box off a store shelf (S) or a woman gasps at a shelf of boxes (L), boxes legible at 0 s
box on lap at home, lid off
room transformed / cozy; hard cut. For shape L continue with B2·S2 + B3 (wearable or decor master)

measured: hollyglow 5.2M END 7.85 s (shortest 1M+ reel in the dataset).
MC 62.8K: drop-off 0:02 — the hook visual must change by 2 s.
rules: Default to shape L on FB (our pages' winners are 12-14.5 s); run shape S as the experiment (it also tests sub-10 s length).
Shopper reaction must peak by 2 s (SHOCK_STORE median 6.2K without a striking reaction, hooks REPORT §1.4).
Do not re-text other families' winning footage into NEEDS (4.2K).
Merry Carrier 62.8K caption 'Your neighbors are gonna be jealous... 🤭❄️' (no link) is the proven envy alternative.

generation_plan.summary: Shape S: 3 gens (H1 + B1 + B2). Shape L: H1 + the 3-gen wearable or decor master.

generations.title: POV shelf grab
generations.inputs: start still (T8): red store shelf of {brand} boxes, US flag overhead; <<<image_1>>> = box art
generations.prompt:
Image-to-video from the start image. POV handheld in a bright big-box store aisle: a woman's hand in a beige sweater reaches up to a red shelf stacked with {brand} boxes from <<<image_1>>> and pulls one box off toward the camera within the first second, slight push-in, busy store ambience, an American flag hanging overhead. No music, no text.
shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.

start_frame.prompt:

An American flag hangs overhead. Sharp, clean, realistic phone photo, top fifth clear for text. No text or graphics.
